name: British Columbia speculation and vacancy tax — 2026 rates
description: Annual tax on residential property in taxable regions of BC that is not a principal residence or long-term rental; rates doubled/raised for the 2026 tax year.

sources.title: Speculation and vacancy tax rates (last updated 3 July 2026)

limitations: Taxable regions were not retrieved (the taxable-areas page returned 404 twice); check before treating a city as in or out. Exemptions (principal residence, long-term rental 6+ months) not stored.
